Makaibari Tea Estate Launches Collective for Darjeeling Growers

The Makaibari Tea Estate has launched the Makaibari Collective initiative in Darjeeling. This collective aims to integrate tea from the Makaibari estate with that of independent small tea growers in the region. The stated goals of the initiative are to ensure better prices for the farmers and provide them with a share of the profits.
